assignments.reason: הִתְחַבְּרוּת וּדְבֵקוּת לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ (bonding and cleaving to God) is essentially the same concept as הִתְחַבְּרוּת already in Package 1. The Rebbe defines תפלה itself as 'לשון התחברות' — prayer IS bonding. This node is the full expression of that same reality: attachment to God through the Shekhinah. By essential nature it belongs to the holy Malkhut/prayer domain.

תְּפִלָּה בְּכֹחַ (forceful prayer) is by essential nature prayer — the dominant node of Package 1. It is not a separate concept but the activated, empowered form of the same תפלה/מלכות. The Rebbe says 'שמתפללים בכח, בזה נותן כח בתפלה' — praying with force gives force TO prayer. The force and the prayer share the same holy Shekhinah domain.

כֹּחַ (force/strength) is the enabling energy of prayer and the Shekhinah. The verse 'כי הוא הנותן לך כח לעשות חיל' is interpreted as: God gives you force to repair אשת חיל = מלכות. By essential nature, this כח is the holy strength that belongs to the prayer/Malkhut domain — it is the force OF the Shekhinah, not a separate conceptual domain.

תְּתַקֵּן אֶת אֵשֶׁת חַיִל (repairing the Eshet Chayil) is essentially the same act as תקון השכינה already in Package 1. The Rebbe says explicitly 'על-ידי הכח תתקן את אשת-חיל, בחינת מלכות' — Eshet Chayil IS Malkhut. Repairing her is repairing the Shekhinah. By essential nature this belongs to the holy Malkhut domain.

נִתְחַדֵּשׁ הַשְּׁבוּעָה לָאָבוֹת (the oath to the Patriarchs is renewed) is the culminating state of the restored Shekhinah. The Rebbe says the Shekhinah clothed in luminous garments 'היא בחינת שבועה' — she IS the oath. The renewal of the oath is therefore the actualization of the Shekhinah's restored state. By essential nature this belongs to the holy Malkhut/Shekhinah domain — the same reality as זווג and הקמת הברית already in Package 1.

assignments.node_id: התקון להגאוה, הינו מלכות הרשעה, גוברת על ישראל
assignments.reason: הַתִּקּוּן לְהַגַּאֲוָה (the tikkun/remedy for pride overpowering Israel) is by essential nature a holy corrective act — the repair that the Shekhinah achieves through empowered prayer. Though it references the evil side (גאוה, מלכות הרשעה) as the object being remedied, the tikkun itself is a holy act of restoration. It belongs to the same domain as the prayer/Malkhut that performs it.

assignments.node_id: נותן כח בתפלה להתחזק כנגד מלכות הרשעה לצאת מגלותא
assignments.reason: נוֹתֵן כֹּחַ בַּתְּפִלָּה לְהִתְחַזֵּק כְּנֶגֶד מַלְכוּת הָרְשָׁעָה לָצֵאת מִגָּלוּתָא (giving strength to prayer to prevail against the wicked kingdom and leave exile) is by essential nature the empowerment of holy prayer/Malkhut. Though it describes the opposition (מלכות הרשעה, גלותא), its essential domain is the Shekhinah gaining strength to emerge — the core subject of Package 1.
